title: The Alienware 15 Gaming Laptop Is Good Enough for Price and Performance
summary: In the current landscape of expensive hardware, the new entry-level gaming laptop from Dell’s Alienware line—the Alienware 15—offers just enough performance capability and quality specs to make it worth the price.
